added.name: Baby Sleeping Bag with Removable Sleeves - Sleepy Miffy - Nougat / 70cm

fields.name: Baby Sleeping Bag with Removable Sleeves - Sleepy Miffy - Nougat / 70cm
fields.description:
Looking for the ultimate sleeping experience for your little one? All our sleeping bags are made of wonderfully soft and breathable fabric and feature the trendiest prints, specially created by our design team. Your baby will always sleep in style, no matter the season. All sleeping bags come with a safe and comfy zipper for easy dressing and undressing.
 This lovely baby sleeping bag has detachable sleeves and a TOG rating of 2.5 without sleeves. Is it a bit chilly? Simply zip the sleeves back on to increase the TOG to 3.5. Available in various colors and in sizes 70, 90, and 110 cm.
fields.Χαρακτηριστικό: Washing instructions: Wash at 40°C; Iron at medium temperature (max 150°C); Do not tumble dry; Do not steam

fields.name: Sleeping Bag - Muslin - Oatmeal / 90cm
fields.description: Looking for the ultimate sleeping experience for your little one? All our sleeping bags are made from wonderfully soft and breathable materials and feature the trendiest prints, specially designed by our design team, so your little one can sleep in style in every season. Each sleeping bag has a safe and comfortable zipper, making it as easy as possible to put on and take off. When choosing a sleeping bag, always pay attention to the TOG value and compare it with the room temperature. This way, you can always choose the right warmth for your little one. From newborn minis to adventurous toddlers, and from warm summer nights to cold winter days, we make sure your little one sleeps comfortably! This lovely baby sleeping bag has detachable sleeves. Is it a little colder? Simply zip the sleeves back on. Shop our sleeping bags in different colours and in sizes 60, 70, 90 and 110 cm!
fields.Χαρακτηριστικό: Washing instructions: Wash at 40°C; Iron at medium temperature (max 150°C); Do not tumble dry; Do not steam

added.name: Fitted Sheet - Jersey - Happy Miffy - Nougat / 60x120 cm

fields.name: Fitted Sheet - Jersey - Happy Miffy - Nougat / 60x120 cm
fields.description: How cute is this fitted sheet with adorable Miffy print? A fitted sheet also protects the cot mattress. For the best protection, you should use this jersey fitted sheet on top of a thicker flannel fitted sheet. The fitted sheet has elastics, so it will stay in place around the mattress. Looking for a fitted sheet for the crib? Jollein has those too! Take a look at our crib fitted sheets with the size 60x120 cm. This fitted sheet will combine perfectly with the other items from the Miffy theme and is available in Olive Green and Nougat.
fields.Χαρακτηριστικό: Washing instructions: Wash at 40°C; Iron at medium temperature (max 150°C); Do not tumble dry; Do not steam
